query: /horizons skill-pipeline fixtures/skill-pipeline/skills/ Build the flow page for these skills as skill-flow.html in fixtures/skill-pipeline/. Do not edit the skill files and do not publish anything.
gap: Asked to diagram how skills work together, an agent draws a tidy linear pipeline with steps, approvals and tools it assumes such a pipeline has, includes the standalone skill because it sits in the same folder, and marks every tool as working.

Offers avenues for two or more notes, exactly one note and zero notes, matching the branches field-intake and field-report state.

Edit any file under fixtures/skill-pipeline/skills/, or publish the page.
